category.description: Njuskalo category to scrape. Used when Start URLs is empty.
category.title: Category

fetchDetails.description: If enabled, fetches each listing's detail page for richer fields (full description, seller info, all images, coordinates, category-specific attributes). Doubles HTTP request count.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch Listing Details

keyword.description: Optional free-text keyword. Appended to the category URL as ?keywords=...
keyword.title: Keyword (optional)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to return (1–10,000).
maxItems.title: Max Items

proxyConfiguration.description: REQUIRED: Njuskalo geo-blocks non-Croatian IPs at the TCP level. Use Apify Residential proxy with apifyProxyCountry='HR'. The default prefill is correct — do not change unless you know what you're doing.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration (required)

startUrls.description: Njuskalo category/search/detail URLs. Apply filters on njuskalo.hr first, then paste the URL. If empty, the Category dropdown is used.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)
